message.content:
I'm planning a full production rebuild of the InkOS calendar page (`/calendar`) for a tattoo studio SaaS (Next.js 16, React 19, TypeScript strict, Tailwind 4, shadcn/ui, Supabase, Dodo Payments). I need a detailed, file-by-file implementation plan.

## What we're building (from the audit PDF)

**Strategic calls:**
1. Default view = Day (already is)
2. Multi-chair side-by-side layout (NEW — currently single-column FullCalendar grid)
3. Smart single-screen booking form replacing 4-step wizard

**Full change list:**
- CUT: Print icon, 4-step wizard (Service→Artist→Time→Client), visible keyboard shortcut strip
- MOVE: Download icon → "..." overflow menu; keyboard shortcuts → "?" tooltip  
- RENAME: "+ New" → "+ New booking"
- ADD: Current date display with Instrument Serif italic; artist multi-select filter; status filter; chair-column grid (core feature); NOW red line indicator; drag-drop to reschedule; resize to change duration; service category color coding; booking status pills (LIVE/PAID/HOLD); blocked time with diagonal stripes; session # meta (S2/3); guest chair column (timboxed residency); smart context-aware form; auto Dodo deposit link on save
- FIX: 2 distinct empty states (db-empty vs day-empty); "No services configured" → link to Settings

## Existing codebase context

### Current files to modify:
- `app/(app)/calendar/_components/CalendarPageClient.tsx` — main orchestrator, TanStack Query fetches `/api/bookings?per_page=500` (but API caps at 100 — BUG), owns drag-reschedule mutation via `PATCH /api/bookings/:id`
- `components/calendar/CalendarView.tsx` — FullCalendar wrapper with `timeGridDay | timeGridWeek | dayGridMonth | listWeek`, custom toolbar, filter row, guest artist strip, empty states. Already has drag+resize via FullCalendar `eventDrop`/`eventResize` with optimistic undo toast.
- `components/calendar/CalendarToolbar.tsx` — sticky bar, view toggle (Day/Week/Month/Agenda), Print icon (CUT), iCal download (MOVE to overflow), "+ New" button (RENAME + keep), swipe gesture handler
- `components/calendar/CalendarFilterRow.tsx` — Artist/Status/Service popovers (keep, enhance)
- `components/calendar/AppointmentCard.tsx` — FullCalendar eventContent, shows client name/time/service/status dot/deposit dot/project chain icon. NEEDS: LIVE/PAID/HOLD pills, session S2/3 meta, service category color coding.
- `app/api/bookings/route.ts` — GET capped at 100 (BUG for calendar). POST creates booking.
- `components/appointments/AppointmentDrawer.tsx` — 4-step wizard Sheet (CUT for calendar-initiated bookings, replace with SmartBookingSheet)

### Key types already defined:
```ts
interface CalendarBooking {
  id: string
  scheduled_at: string
  end_at: string
  duration_min: number
  status: 'pending'|'confirmed'|'in_progress'|'completed'|'cancelled'|'no_show'
  client: { id: string; first_name: string; last_name: string | null }
  artist: { id: string; display_name: string; avatar_url: string | null; sort_order: number }
  service: { id: string; name: string; color: string | null } | null
  deposit_cents?: number | null
  deposit_paid?: boolean | null
  project_id?: string | null
  session_number?: number | null
  project?: { name: string } | null
}
```

### Existing utilities/hooks:
- `useCalendarDrawer` hook — manages drawer open/editingId/defaultStart/defaultEnd
- `hooks/calendar/use-calendar-drawer.ts` 
- `lib/rate-limit.ts` — `apiRatelimit`, `authedRatelimit`
- `lib/audit.ts` — `logAuditAction(actorId, action, target, details, studioId)`
- `lib/queue.ts` — `enqueueJob('send-sms', { commId, studioId })` for auto-SMS on reschedule

### Available shadcn primitives: Dialog, Sheet, Popover, DropdownMenu, Command, Badge, Avatar, Tooltip, ScrollArea, Skeleton, Button, Input, Select, Combobox

### Brand tokens (globals.css @theme inline):
- Colors: `--color-bone: #F7F7F5`, `--color-onyx: #0F0F0F`, `--color-stone: #787774`, `--color-rust: #B23A2B`
- Shadows: `shadow-soft`, `shadow-card`, `shadow-card-hover`, `shadow-soft-md`, `shadow-lift`
- Typography: Instrument Serif for serif display (Tailwind class `font-serif`)
- Status colors: `--color-status-pending`, `--color-status-confirmed`, `--color-status-in-progress`, `--color-status-completed`, `--color-status-cancelled`, `--color-status-no-show`

### Architecture constraints:
- Tailwind 4 — all tokens in `globals.css @theme inline`, NO `tailwind.config.ts`
- No `any` types
- Rate-limit all API routes with `authedRatelimit`
- Dual-layer feature gate: `requireFeatureRpc` + `<FeatureGate>`
- `calendar` feature key is always-on (all plans)
- `guest_artists` feature key requires Pro+
- `sms_reminders` feature key requires Studio+
- Workers handle SMS sends (never from web), use `enqueueJob('send-sms', ...)`
- No hardcoded hex colors in components — use token classes only
- Font: `font-sans` for UI, `font-serif` for display/titles

## The multi-chair grid decision

The most complex ADD is the multi-chair Day view. Two options:
1. **FullCalendar Resource Time Grid** (premium plugin `@fullcalendar/resource-timegrid`) — requires license
2. **Custom CSS Grid component** — full control, tattoo-native, no premium dep

Recommend option 2 (custom grid) because:
- FullCalendar resource plugin is premium/paid
- We need full control over LIVE/PAID/HOLD pills, session meta, diagonal stripe blocked slots
- The NOW line implementation matches the dashboard pattern
- We keep FullCalendar for Week/Month/Agenda views (they work fine)

## What I need from you

Produce a complete file-by-file implementation plan covering:

1. Files to CREATE (name, purpose, key props/interfaces, implementation approach)
2. Files to MODIFY (name, what changes, what stays)
3. API changes needed
4. The drag-drop + resize strategy for the custom DayChairGrid (use HTML5 pointer events or check if @dnd-kit is in deps)
5. Service category color system (audit says: Neo-traditional=pink, Fine-line=green, Black&grey=stone, Color=amber — but InkOS brand has 4 colors only. How to handle color coding without violating brand rules?)
6. The SmartBookingSheet form fields + validation schema
7. How auto-deposit link works (Dodo Payments, not Stripe — existing `/api/public/deposits/checkout` endpoint)
8. Empty state strategy (db-empty vs day-empty)

Be specific with file paths, interfaces, and implementation details.

1	/**
2	 * Job queue — typed enqueuer for BullMQ workers.
3	 *
4	 * This module ONLY enqueues. Workers (in workers/jobs/) process the jobs.
5	 * The web app never imports BullMQ directly — just this typed enqueuer.
6	 *
7	 * Falls back to a warning log when REDIS_URL is absent (local dev without Redis).
8	 * In production, REDIS_URL must be set or all background jobs silently drop.
9	 */
10	import 'server-only'
11	import { logger } from '@/lib/logger'
12	
13	// ─── Job payload types ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
14	// Each job name maps to a strongly-typed payload.
15	// Adding a new job: add entry here + handler in workers/jobs/
16	
17	export interface JobPayloadMap {
18	  // Generic email dispatch — worker routes to template
19	  'send-email': {
20	    to: string
21	    template: string
22	    data: Record<string, unknown>
23	  }
24	
25	  // AI design generation
26	  'process-ai-design': {
27	    requestId: string
28	    studioId: string
29	  }
30	
31	  // Calendar sync
32	  'sync-calendar': {
33	    studioId: string
34	    artistId?: string
35	  }
36	
37	  // Consent form PDF generation
38	  'generate-consent-pdf': {
39	    submission_id: string
40	    studio_id: string
41	  }
42	
43	  // Tax form PDF generation
44	  'generate-tax-form-pdf': {
45	    form_id: string
46	    studio_id: string
47	  }
48	
49	  // Tax form send to artist
50	  'send-tax-form': {
51	    form_id: string
52	    studio_id: string
53	    sent_by: string
54	  }
55	
56	  // Marketing campaign dispatch
57	  'send-marketing-campaign': {
58	    campaignId: string
59	    studioId: string
60	    triggeredBy: string
61	  }
62	
63	  // Payroll CSV export
64	  'payroll-csv-export': {
65	    preset: string
66	    from: string
67	    to: string
68	    studioId: string
69	  }
70	
71	  // SMS send — worker reads comm row, calls Twilio, updates status + provider_message_id
72	  'send-sms': {
73	    commId: string     // client_communications.id
74	    studioId: string
75	  }
76	
77	  // S24c — Consent-form auto-dispatch. Evaluator (lib/consent/evaluate-
78	  // auto-send-rules.ts) enqueues this per matching rule on booking
79	  // lifecycle events. Worker creates the consent_form_requests row + fires
80	  // the SMS/email with a one-time signing URL.
81	  'send-consent-form': {
82	    ruleId: string
83	    bookingId: string
84	    clientId: string
85	    studioId: string
86	  }
87	}
88	
89	export type JobName = keyof JobPayloadMap
90	
91	// ─── Queue configuration ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────
92	const QUEUE_NAME = 'inkos-jobs'
93	
94	// ─── Lazy queue instance ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────
95	// Defined via interface to avoid importing BullMQ types at module level
96	interface QueueAddResult {
97	  id?: string | null
98	}
99	interface QueueInstance {
100	  add: (name: string, data: unknown, opts?: Record<string, unknown>) => Promise<QueueAddResult>
101	}
102	
103	let _queue: QueueInstance | null = null
104	let _queueInitFailed = false
105	
106	async function getQueue(): Promise<QueueInstance | null> {
107	  if (_queueInitFailed) return null
108	  if (_queue) return _queue
109	
110	  const redisUrl = process.env.REDIS_URL
111	  if (!redisUrl) {
112	    return null
113	  }
114	
115	  try {
116	    // Dynamic import so the web app bundle never includes BullMQ
117	    // The `as string` cast avoids static analysis bundling it
118	    const bullmq = await import('bullmq' as string) as { Queue: new (name: string, opts: unknown) => QueueInstance }
119	    _queue = new bullmq.Queue(QUEUE_NAME, {
120	      connection: {
121	        url: redisUrl,
122	        maxRetriesPerRequest: null,  // required for BullMQ ioredis compatibility
123	      },
124	      defaultJobOptions: {
125	        attempts: 3,
126	        backoff: { type: 'exponential', delay: 5_000 },
127	        removeOnComplete: 100,
128	        removeOnFail: 500,
129	      },
130	    })
131	    return _queue
132	  } catch (err) {
133	    _queueInitFailed = true
134	    logger.error({ err }, 'queue: failed to initialize BullMQ — jobs will be dropped')
135	    return null
136	  }
137	}
138	
139	// ─── enqueueJob ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
140	
141	export async function enqueueJob<T extends JobName>(
142	  jobName: T,
143	  payload: JobPayloadMap[T],
144	  opts?: { delay?: number; priority?: number },
145	): Promise<{ id: string }> {
146	  const queue = await getQueue()
147	
148	  if (!queue) {
149	    logger.warn(
150	      { jobName },
151	      'queue: REDIS_URL not set or queue unavailable — job dropped (set REDIS_URL in .env.local for full functionality)',
152	    )
153	    return { id: `noop-${Date.now()}` }
154	  }
155	
156	  try {
157	    const job = await queue.add(jobName, payload, {
158	      ...(opts?.delay !== undefined && { delay: opts.delay }),
159	      ...(opts?.priority !== undefined && { priority: opts.priority }),
160	    })
161	    logger.info({ jobName, jobId: job.id }, 'queue: job enqueued')
162	    return { id: job.id ?? `queued-${Date.now()}` }
163	  } catch (err) {
164	    logger.error({ err, jobName }, 'queue: failed to enqueue job')
165	    throw err
166	  }
167	}
